dialogues.speaker: Mikoshi Genichirou
dialogues.text: Hello, see anything you like? If you can't find the right one, I can have one custom-made for you.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I've got some treasure I want to sell.

dialogues.speaker: Mikoshi Genichirou
dialogues.text: Eh? Well, to tell you the truth, we've managed to restore a regular supply of goods, and we don't really make collecting odds and ends a habit, in any case...

dialogues.speaker: Mikoshi Genichirou
dialogues.text: But just from looking at you, I think it's safe to assume that it's something most interesting indeed.

dialogues.speaker: Mikoshi Genichirou
dialogues.text: Well... Why don't you let me have a look at it, then?

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: You tell Mikoshi Genichirou about the Dragonbone Orb.

dialogues.speaker: Mikoshi Genichirou
dialogues.text: I'll be honest with you. While this is quite the curious tale, it does seem a bit too out there...

dialogues.speaker: Mikoshi Genichirou
dialogues.text: This object falls somewhat outside my area of expertise.

dialogues.speaker: Mikoshi Genichirou
dialogues.text: Please, don't scoff. I am but a mere craftsman myself...

dialogues.speaker: Mikoshi Genichirou
dialogues.text: How about this, then? 80,000 and 5 Sashimi Platters. Those dishes aren't cheap by any means, mind you.

dialogues.speaker: Mikoshi Genichirou
dialogues.text: If you agree to this price, I will buy this treasure.

response.speaker: Mikoshi Genichirou
response.text: I'm not sure at the moment. I'll need to give it some thought.

response.speaker: Mikoshi Genichirou
response.text: If the situation is right, I might be able to modify this into a special netsuke and sell it for a decent price.

response.speaker: Mikoshi Genichirou
response.text: In that case, please take this Mora. As for me, I'm going to go look into this item.

choices.text: Let me think about it a bit more.

response.speaker: Mikoshi Genichirou
response.text: Fair enough. I need to give this a little thought myself.

response.speaker: Mikoshi Genichirou
response.text: You can come to me again once you've thought things over.

dialogues.speaker: Mikoshi Genichirou
dialogues.text: Have you decided to sell me the Dragonbone Orb, then?

dialogues.speaker: Mikoshi Genichirou
dialogues.text: The price is the same as before. 80,000 Mora and 5 Sashimi Platters.

response.speaker: Mikoshi Genichirou
response.text: In that case, please take this Mora. As for me, I'm going to go look into this item.

choices.text: Let me think about it one more time.

response.speaker: Mikoshi Genichirou
response.text: Fair enough. I need to give this a little thought myself.

response.speaker: Mikoshi Genichirou
response.text: You can come to me again once you've thought things over.
